description: Object composition. Objects are written in place ({field: value}); object gives such a value a declared type and a node other nodes can read; merge is Object.assign.

object.description: Answers value unchanged, as the declared type. Write the object in place: "in": { "value": { "title": "{{in.title}}", "status": "{{const.initial}}" }, "type": "@shapes/Task.shape.json" }. The checker verifies the object is assignable to type.

type.description: the declared type of the result

merge.description: over laid on top of base -- every key of over wins -- answered as the declared type. Like Object.assign({}, base, over).

type.description: the declared type of the result
